network: The server couldn't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
internal: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
validation_failed: Some of the information sent isn't valid.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
payload_too_large: That is too large to send.
unsupported_media_type: That kind of content isn't supported.
auth_invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth_account_locked: This account is locked after too many failed sign-ins. Try again later or ask an admin to reset your password.
auth_registration_disabled: Self-registration is turned off on this instance.
auth_email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
auth_password_too_long: The password is too long (at most {{maxBytes}} bytes).
auth_password_too_short: The password is too short (at least {{minLength}} characters).
import_too_large: The file is too large to import (at most {{maxBytes}} bytes).
import_invalid_quiz: The quiz still has errors, so it can't be saved.
admin_last_admin: This is the last active admin, so the change isn't allowed.
service_unavailable: A required service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
test_archived: This test is archived, so it can't be practised.
practice_attempt_in_progress: You already have an attempt in progress on this test. Resume it or discard it first.
practice_attempt_submitted: This attempt has been submitted, so it can't be changed.
practice_attempt_not_submitted: This attempt hasn't been submitted yet.
practice_answer_locked: This answer has already been checked, so it can't be changed.
practice_nothing_to_retake: Nothing was missed in the last attempt, so there's nothing to retake.
practice_question_not_in_attempt: That question isn't part of this attempt.
practice_self_grade_not_allowed: Only a short answer marked incorrect can be self-graded.
llm_role_unassigned: No model is assigned to this role yet.
llm_cloud_blocked: Local endpoints only is on, so this can't use a cloud endpoint.
llm_cloud_roles_assigned: Local endpoints only can't be turned on while these roles use a cloud endpoint: {{roles}}.
llm_endpoint_unreachable: The model endpoint can't be reached.
llm_endpoint_auth: The model endpoint rejected the key, or the stored key can't be read.
llm_endpoint_timeout: The model endpoint took too long to answer.
llm_endpoint_error: The model endpoint returned an error.
llm_endpoint_in_use: A role uses this endpoint. Assign the role elsewhere first.
llm_models_unsupported: This endpoint can't list its models. Enter the model id by hand.
llm_output_invalid: The model's output was still invalid after repairs.
llm_output_incomplete: The model stopped before finishing its reply. Raise the role's max output tokens, or turn the model's thinking off in its parameters.
llm_context_exceeded: The prompt doesn't fit in the context window once max output tokens are reserved. Lower the role's max output tokens, or use a larger context window.
llm_embedding_truncated: A text is too long for the embedding model and would be cut off.
llm_secret_key_missing: ENDPOINT_SECRET_KEY isn't configured, so a key can't be saved.
llm_eval_running: An evaluation is already running for this role.
verify_unavailable: The answer checker isn't available right now. Try again in a minute.
verify_program_too_large: A check program is too long to run.
verify_fix_invalid: That suggested fix doesn't match the verification results.
